body:
Worker rule (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-28 22:35Z; my own slip on Group B r7, confirmed by Fable2 #858).

Once a /review-code pair is spawned on a frozen root, that root is HANDS-OFF until the fan-in. Read-only reviewers read the live working tree, so an edit made while they run makes them review a moving mix of two inputs. The host also records those edits as workspace changes observed during the delegation.

What happened: I froze Group B r7 (939655d0) and spawned the pair. A coordinator message that had crossed mine then required more tests, and I edited the root while the pair ran. I had to cancel the pair unused (cc149452, 98e83cbb), re-freeze as r8 and spawn a new pair.

Rule:
- If a new requirement arrives after the spawn, CANCEL the pair first (termal_cancel_session), then edit, then re-freeze (tree, patch, archive), then spawn a fresh pair.
- Never edit under live reviewers.
- Before freezing, re-read the mailbox for crossed messages that add requirements, so the freeze is final.
- Disclose any cancelled pair in the next freeze's INDEX, and never cite its results.
